title: Questionnaire-based machine learning predicted congenital heart disease in a retrospective case-control study
summary: A retrospective multicenter case-control study used questionnaire data and explainable machine-learning models to identify factors associated with congenital heart disease and predict case status. The best reported model had modest discrimination, including on an external hospital sample; this is not causal evidence.
ai_technology: LASSO feature selection and comparison of support-vector machine, XGBoost, random forest, logistic regression and LightGBM models, interpreted with SHAP.
organization: Children’s Hospital, Zhejiang University; Innovation Center for Child Health, Zhejiang University

evidence.tested: XGBoost achieved AUC 0.724 internally and 0.706 in an external sample of 285; echocardiography supplied the reference diagnosis.
evidence.unknown: Retrospective case-control prediction with modest discrimination; associations do not establish causal risk factors or clinical benefit.
evidence.ai_role: LASSO feature selection and comparison of support-vector machine, XGBoost, random forest, logistic regression and LightGBM models, interpreted with SHAP.

source_review.scope: Primary result-bearing material for the stated method, result and evaluation, with bibliographic version information.
